We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.<\/p>\n<p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.<\/p>\n<p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.<\/p><\/div><p><strong>Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager, Deliveroo Express&nbsp;<\/strong><\/p>\n<p>At Deliveroo, our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting customers, restaurants, shops and riders. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, when and where they want it.<\/p>\n<p>We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.<\/p>\n<p><strong>The Team<\/strong><\/p>\n<p>This role sits within the New Verticals business unit on our Global Strategy, Product and Commercial team, reporting into the Head of Strategic Partnerships, Deliveroo Express with our broader team reporting up into the Director, GM of Drive EMEA and VP of EMEA Markets. We are responsible for setting the strategy and lighting up new verticals, ensuring that Deliveroo has the right to win in the new and highly competitive on-demand Grocery and Retail market. The culture within the&nbsp; team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast.&nbsp;<\/p>\n<p><strong>The Role<\/strong><\/p>\n<p>Deliveroo Express is Deliveroo's white-label solution that allows our partners to offer on-demand delivery directly through their own online websites \/ apps. Imagine going onto your favourite restaurant, grocer or retailers' website and having an order delivered in as little as 20 minutes - from the customer's point of view, you're ordering directly with the restaurant \/ grocery \/ retailer, and it's simply delivered by our rapid riders. For more, please see: <a href=\"https:\/\/merchants.deliveroo.com\/what-we-offer\/deliveroo-express\">https:\/\/merchants.deliveroo.com\/what-we-offer\/deliveroo-express<\/a><\/p>\n<p>As a Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager in the team, you will manage the day-to-day relationships with our white-label partners, which includes leading regular performance reviews, identifying opportunities for growth and overcoming operational challenges. You will work closely with various functions of Deliveroo to share insights from partners and ensure we are developing a \"best in class\" value proposition. With Deliveroo Express being a new product launched in April, you will play a pivotal role in defining the on-going strategy and driving success of this proposition.&nbsp;<\/p>\n<p>Using data to understand trends in performance and identify opportunities for operational excellence will be critical to your success in the role. You will need to be able to manage multiple projects at once, interacting with key functions such as Product, Operations and Commercial. You will use your business acumen and negotiation skills to win new business deals and build an on-going pipeline.<\/p>\n<p>Working with partners of this scale, you will often overcome challenges that Deliveroo is facing for the first time, helping to shape the future of how we work with and scale our white-label partners.&nbsp;<\/p>\n<h2>&nbsp;<\/h2>\n<p><strong>Key Responsibilities<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>Directly own the day-day relationship with Deliveroo Express partners across all verticals - Restaurants, Grocery and Retail<\/li>\n<li>Analyse and present insights on performance against KPIs during weekly\/monthly\/quarterly meetings and reviews<\/li>\n<li>Conduct detailed analysis and extract insights to deliver operational excellence and identify ways to course-correct if needed<\/li>\n<li>Identify opportunities to deepen and grow our partner relationships&nbsp;<\/li>\n<li>Develop on-going sales strategy for Deliveroo Express including pipeline development across markets, with support from your Commercial lead<\/li>\n<li>Conduct new business pitching and commercial negotiation for new partners, with support from your Commercial lead<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p><strong>Qualities We're Looking For<\/strong><\/p>\n<ol>\n<li>DECISIVE AND INFLUENTIAL: \u200byou should thrive in a fast-paced environment, and be comfortable with making fast decisions, even in times of ambiguity and based on intuition. You are comfortable making recommendations and communicating them across the business persuasively. More importantly, you must have a strong desire to galvanise action within Deliveroo, thinking about the big picture but also not afraid to get into the weeds of a problem to get things done.<\/li>\n<li>ANALYTICAL AND COLLABORATIVE: \u200bthere will be some number-crunching involved, but your role will also be about stepping back \u2013 you'll need to see the bigger picture and understand how your insights are aligned with the direction the business is heading in.&nbsp;<\/li>\n<li>COMMERCIAL: you will need to excel in building relationships with local commercial teams, and external partners and understand how best to bring our proposition to grocers and retailers. You will need to build a deep understanding of the Deliveroo P&amp;L and operations of the business.<\/li>\n<\/ol>\n<h2>&nbsp;<\/h2>\n<p><strong>Requirements:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>4-6 years' experience in an account management, grocery\/retail operations or strategy \/ strategic partnerships role.&nbsp;<\/li>\n<li><strong>Confident <\/strong>in analysing data and extracting compelling and actionable insights<\/li>\n<li>Strong <strong>operational mindset <\/strong>to identify opportunities for excellence and course-correct when needed&nbsp;<\/li>\n<li><strong>Partner obsessed<\/strong>, with effective relationship building, organisation and <strong>communication skills<\/strong><\/li>\n<li><strong>Collaborative team player<\/strong> who is able to get the best out of the people around you. Able to work effectively with various teams and all levels of Deliveroo.<\/li>\n<li>Experienced <strong>negotiator <\/strong>within the ability to drive mutual value for both partners and Deliveroo<\/li>\n<li>London-based with a minimum of three days required in the office&nbsp;<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p><strong>Nice to have:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>Experience working with FMCG \/ grocery \/ retailer e-commerce or last mile operations preferable.<\/li>\n<li>Experience in working in a dynamic high-growth company is preferable<\/li>\n<\/ul><div class=\"content-conclusion\"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion<\/strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. Summit:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit\u2019s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Summit\u2019s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit\u2019s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Colorectal Cancer (CRC)&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China\u2019s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoMsg_Job&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;iCIMS_Expandable_Container&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;iCIMS_Expandable_Text&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoMsg_Job&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;iCIMS_Expandable_Container&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;iCIMS_Expandable_Text&quot;&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What do we need&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for an experienced market leader, thought leader and SME in Lab Automation and Orchestration.&lt;br&gt;Lab automation is where science meets engineering. Robotics, liquid handlers, instruments, and scheduling software are moving labs from manual work toward automated, data driven, and eventually autonomous operation. While we are supporting fully automated labs, most labs still run as islands. Instruments speak different languages, workflows are hard to change, and the data that comes off the line rarely arrives ready for analysis or AI.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u2019re building Luma, a Scientific Intelligence Platform for life sciences and materials science. Lab Orchestration and automation are core to our Molecule to Market story, and they connect directly to the strengths of Siemens in industrial automation. We need someone to own the market strategy for it.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a customer and market facing role. You\u2019ll spend real time with lab automation leaders at pharma, biotech, CDMOs, and research institutes across the UK and Europe, hearing what they need and bringing it back to the business. You\u2019ll also support teams around the world across Siemens, including sales, product, services, customer success, and the Siemens Solution Marketing team, so everyone can speak to the lab automation market with confidence and one consistent story. You\u2019ll work with industry thought leaders to shape the conversation on autonomous labs and AI. Your job is to drive software adoption and AI use cases in lab automation. You will shape where we play, who we sell to, how we position, and how we win.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;How you\u2019ll spend your time&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Customer engagements: meeting automation leaders, scientists, and engineers, joining pursuits, and bringing what you hear back to the business&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Market analysis: sizing segments, tracking competitors and automation vendors, and spotting trends early&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Sales enablement: giving teams across regions the talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and proof points to win&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Solution marketing: partnering with the Siemens Solution Marketing team on content, campaigns, events, and messaging for the lab automation audience&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Thought leadership: working with industry thought leaders, inside and outside Siemens, to shape the conversation on self driving labs and the future of the automated lab&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Adoption and AI use cases: identifying, proving, and spreading the use cases that get labs running on Luma and putting AI to work on automated workflows and data&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner and ecosystem engagement: working with instrument makers, robotics providers, and integrators so our joint story is clear to customers&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Cross organization alignment: working across Siemens DISW and DI Automation teams so we show up as one company with one story for the lab automation market&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The goal is simple. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Join our Product and Regulatory Legal team, embedded with Kraken's Product, Design and Engineering teams to ship novel products and experiences that accelerate the global adoption of crypto. We are a tight, experienced group of lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice, partnering directly with Product, senior leadership and Compliance to chart clear, defensible paths to launch and to keep our licensed entities running smoothly.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This is a senior product-facing legal role for the European Union. You will be the lawyer the business trusts on questions that cut across several regimes at once: for example, a single product such as a tokenised equity, a card, or an institutional custody and prime brokerage service can touch the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (\"MiFID II\"), the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (\"MiCA\"), the Payment Services Directive (\"PSD2\"), the Electronic Money Directive (\"EMD2\") and banking rules at the same time. You will bring clarity on which regime applies, what it requires, and how to launch within it.<\/p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\">\u00a0<\/div><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h2><strong>The opportunity<\/strong><\/h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Reporting to the Head of Product Legal, you will  act as a senior legal adviser to European leadership on new products, licensing structure and regulatory strategy.<\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own cross-functional product counselling for European Union launches from discovery to design, launch and iteration, giving Product, Engineering, Compliance and leadership decision-ready advice with clear options and risk trade-offs<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Advise on the regulatory perimeter and classification of new offerings across MiFID II and the Markets in Financial Instruments Regulation (\"MiFIR\"), MiCA, the European Market Infrastructure Regulation (\"EMIR\"), payment services and electronic money rules, and banking regulation, including where an instrument or service falls between regimes (for example tokenised securities, crypto-asset derivatives, margin and financing, and stablecoin-linked products)<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Advise on payments and electronic money offerings, including the Krak card and account propositions, safeguarding, open banking and account-access obligations, and the developing Payment Services Directive 3 and Payment Services Regulation framework<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Advise on banking-related questions that arise in the European Union, including bank partnerships and sponsor-bank arrangements, deposit-taking and lending perimeter questions, the Capital Requirements Regulation and Directive, and the interaction of these rules with our custody, prime brokerage and financing products<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Monitor and interpret European Union legislative and supervisory developments, take part in consultations and industry association work where appropriate, and translate their significance for the business proactively<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Draft and negotiate client-facing terms and conditions, taking clear, business-aligned positions<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Act as gatekeeper for European Union outside counsel engagements: scope the work, estimate and manage cost, and sign off before matters go externally<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Mentor and develop more junior lawyers in the team, set quality standards for plain-English, risk-based advice, and act as a senior sounding board for colleagues across the Regulatory Legal team<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Use AI-assisted tools (for example Enterprise GPTs) to speed up regulatory analysis, first drafts and matter tracking, and to build self-service tools that let stakeholders answer commoditised legal and regulatory questions themselves<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Advise on anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing requirements affecting products, including the Transfer of Funds Regulation (\"Travel Rule\") and the new European Union anti-money laundering package, and on market abuse, conduct, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including the Digital Operational Resilience Act (\"DORA\")<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Lead or oversee licensing, authorisation and variation workstreams in the European Union, including scoping requirements, mapping pathways, supervising outside counsel, preparing application materials and managing regulator interactions<\/p><\/li><\/ul><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\">\u00a0<\/div><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\">\u00a0<\/div><h2><strong>What you bring<\/strong><\/h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Qualified lawyer admitted in Ireland, England and Wales, or another European Union Member State<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">15 or more years' post-qualification experience (\"PQE\") in financial services regulatory law, gained at a regulated financial services institution (for example a bank, payment institution, broker-dealer, exchange, central counterparty or crypto services provider) or at a leading law firm supporting such clients, ideally with in-house or direct product counselling experience<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Deep, current knowledge of several of the following, with real depth in at least two: MiFID II and MiFIR (investment services, market structure, derivatives and conduct), MiCA (crypto-asset services, custody, trading platforms and stablecoins), European Union payment services and electronic money regulation, and European Union banking regulation<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Demonstrated ability to analyse novel products against overlapping regimes and give a clear view on classification and perimeter, including in areas where the rules are unsettled or supervisors have not yet spoken<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Direct experience managing senior regulator relationships, including notifications, information requests, supervisory correspondence and examinations<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Working knowledge of anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including DORA<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Proven ability to instruct, supervise and manage the cost of outside counsel across multiple jurisdictions<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Outstanding Architecture &amp;amp; Design de Solution&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;im&quot;&gt;Concevoir l&#39;architecture cible de l&#39;\u00e9cosyst\u00e8me SAP (Core ERP, extensions, int\u00e9grations) en garantissant la coh\u00e9rence globale, la performance, la s\u00e9curit\u00e9 et la scalabilit\u00e9.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;D\u00e9finir les patterns d&#39;int\u00e9gration hybrides entre SAP (S\/4HANA, SAP Business Technology Platform) et les applications tierces ou plateformes Data\/Cloud de l&#39;entreprise.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;im&quot;&gt;Veiller au respect des principes du &lt;em&gt;Clean Core&lt;\/em&gt; pour faciliter les mises \u00e0 niveau et maintenir l&#39;agilit\u00e9 du SI.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;3. Expertise Technique &amp;amp; Support aux \u00c9quipes&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Guider les \u00e9quipes d&#39;int\u00e9gration (consultants fonctionnels\/techniques) lors des phases de conception d\u00e9taill\u00e9e et d&#39;impl\u00e9mentation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;im&quot;&gt;Veiller au respect des standards d&#39;architecture et aux bonnes pratiques de s\u00e9curit\u00e9.R\u00e9soudre les probl\u00e9matiques complexes d&#39;architecture et de performance (&lt;em&gt;troubleshooting&lt;\/em&gt; avanc\u00e9).&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;4. Veille &amp;amp; \u00c9vang\u00e9lisation&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Assurer une veille technologique constante sur les \u00e9volutions de l&#39;\u00e9diteur SAP (innovations S\/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Business AI).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;im&quot;&gt;Animer la communaut\u00e9 technique interne du domaine, former et faire monter en comp\u00e9tences les \u00e9quipes sur les nouvelles fonctionnalit\u00e9s et usages de l&#39;IA.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&amp;nbsp;Exp\u00e9rience requise&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Exp\u00e9rience globale :&lt;\/strong&gt; Minimum 8 \u00e0 10 ans d&#39;exp\u00e9rience dans l&#39;\u00e9cosyst\u00e8me SAP, dont au moins 3 \u00e0 5 ans sur un r\u00f4le d&#39;Architecte Solution, Lead Tech ou Staff Engineer.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Projets significatifs :&lt;\/strong&gt; Exp\u00e9rience r\u00e9ussie sur des projets de transformation\/migration vers SAP S\/4HANA et sur le d\u00e9ploiement de solutions Cloud\/Hybrides.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;P\u00e9rim\u00e8tre m\u00e9tier :&lt;\/strong&gt; Exp\u00e9rience approfondie sur les processus de la &lt;strong&gt;Supply Chain amont&lt;\/strong&gt; (planification, production\/MRP, gestion des stocks, Order Management).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;Comp\u00e9tences attendues&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Comp\u00e9tences Techniques (Hard Skills)&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;\u00c9cosyst\u00e8me SAP :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Ma\u00eetrise approfondie de &lt;strong&gt;SAP S\/4HANA&lt;\/strong&gt; (modules cl\u00e9s Supply: MM, PP, SD).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Solides connaissances et pratique de la &lt;strong&gt;SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)&lt;\/strong&gt; (Workzone, CTMS, ABAP Env).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;im&quot;&gt;Connaissance des outils d&#39;automatisation et de gestion des processus : &lt;strong&gt;SAP BPA&lt;\/strong&gt; (&lt;em&gt;Build Process Automation&lt;\/em&gt;).&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;La connaissance des solutions &lt;strong&gt;Public&lt;\/strong&gt; &lt;strong&gt;Cloud&lt;\/strong&gt; de SAP est un plus (IBP, SAC, ...)&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Intelligence Artificielle &amp;amp; Innovation :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Connaissance et compr\u00e9hension des solutions IA de SAP (&lt;strong&gt;Joule&lt;\/strong&gt;, SAP Business AI).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 concevoir l&#39;int\u00e9gration de mod\u00e8les IA (propres ou \u00e9diteurs) avec les donn\u00e9es et processus SAP.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;im&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Architecture &amp;amp; SAP.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Comp\u00e9tences Relationnelles (Soft Skills)&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Vision strat\u00e9gique &amp;amp; Vulgarisation :&lt;\/strong&gt; Capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 traduire des enjeux m\u00e9tiers complexes en architectures techniques, et \u00e0 expliquer des sujets techniques \u00e0 des d\u00e9cideurs fonctionnels.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Leadership technique :&lt;\/strong&gt; Capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 inspirer, orienter et faire grandir les \u00e9quipes engineering sans lien hi\u00e9rarchique direct.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Pragmatisme &amp;amp; Orientation R\u00e9sultat :&lt;\/strong&gt; Capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 arbitrer entre perfection technique, co\u00fbts, et valeur m\u00e9tier rapide.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Anglais courant :&lt;\/strong&gt; Indispensable pour interagir dans un environnement international et avec les \u00e9diteurs\/partenaires.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;CE QUE NOUS T\u2019OFFRONS&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Organisation de travail hybride ;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Mat\u00e9riel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements soci\u00e9taux (Mac ou Windows) ;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Une \u00e9quipe de projet locale au sein d&#39;un r\u00e9seau mondial (possibilit\u00e9 de carri\u00e8re internationale) ;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;D\u00e9veloppement des comp\u00e9tences et accompagnement (diversit\u00e9 des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Package de r\u00e9mun\u00e9ration (actionnariat salari\u00e9, bonus mensuels\/trimestriels).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L&#39;INCLUSION ET DE L&#39;ACCESSIBILITE&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l&#39;immense valeur qu&#39;apporte la diversit\u00e9 \u00e0 nos \u00e9quipes et nous nous effor\u00e7ons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et \u00e9quitable : c&#39;est pourquoi l&#39;Inclusion est l&#39;un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. You\u2019ll work as part of a focused three-person team alongside one Account Executive and one Account Manager, together responsible for landing new accounts and expanding within them across the region. The customers you\u2019ll work with are AI labs, research institutions, and enterprises running some of the most demanding GPU workloads in the world. This is a role for someone who shows up with substance, who can hold a real conversation about model training and MLOps tooling in the morning and cluster networking in the afternoon, and who finds the space between infrastructure and application more interesting than either on its own.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Role:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As an Account Solution Architect covering Northern EMEA, you\u2019ll move across the full stack depending on what the customer needs, from ML training workflows and MLOps platforms like Weights &amp;amp; Biases to bare metal GPU infrastructure and physical AI deployments. This isn\u2019t a role built around a single layer of the stack, but the majority of your conversations will live in the ML layer. You\u2019ll be expected to go deeper than most when the infrastructure conversation demands it, while staying commercially aware enough to support both new logo pursuits and in-flight account expansion. This role requires up to 40% travel.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;In this role, you will:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Cover Northern EMEA, with a focus on the Nordics and Benelux regions (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work closely with one Account Executive and one Account Manager as a dedicated three-person unit, supporting the full land and expand motion across the region.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead technical discovery with prospects and existing customers to understand model training requirements, MLOps workflows, and infrastructure constraints.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design and present solutions spanning ML infrastructure, GPU compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes-based orchestration, and MLOps tooling.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Run proof-of-concept engagements and architecture reviews, and see them through to a decision.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the internal voice of the customer, feeding technical requirements and product gaps back to Engineering and Product.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain clear documentation of customer architectures, solution designs, and outstanding technical questions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Who You Are:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;3+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or solutions architecture role, ideally with a focus on AI\/ML platforms, cloud infrastructure, or HPC.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong working knowledge of ML training and inference workflows - you understand how models are built, optimized, and deployed, not just where they run.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on familiarity with MLOps platforms and the tooling AI teams use day-to-day, including experiment tracking, pipeline orchestration, and model serving.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfortable going below the SaaS layer when the conversation demands it - GPU topology, network fabric, and cluster architecture shouldn\u2019t be unfamiliar territory.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads at scale.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong communication skills - you can adjust your register from a research engineer to a VP of Infrastructure without losing credibility at either end.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience managing multiple concurrent opportunities across a geographic territory.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fluency in English required; proficiency in Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, or Finnish is a plus.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100, A100, H200) and the software stack around them: CUDA, NCCL, cuDNN.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working knowledge of high-performance networking concepts: InfiniBand, RDMA, RoCE, TCP\/IP.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Background working directly with AI labs, research institutions, or enterprise ML teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Exposure to physical AI use cases and the infrastructure requirements they bring.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Wondering if you\u2019re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams - even if you aren\u2019t a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we\u2019ve found compatible with our team. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant o\u00f9 les collaborateurs motiv\u00e9s et ambitieux peuvent d\u00e9velopper leurs comp\u00e9tences, \u00e9tendre leur r\u00e9seau et \u00e9laborer des strat\u00e9gies innovantes pour les plus grandes marques. Notre engagement envers le d\u00e9veloppement de nos talents se traduit par des opportunit\u00e9s de formation, des programmes de mentorat avec des leaders du secteur, et une culture d&#39;entreprise stimulante et inclusive qui encourage la collaboration et l&#39;innovation. Nous avons \u00e9galement mis en place des programmes de reconnaissance et de fid\u00e9lisation pour nos meilleurs talents. Nous investissons dans nos collaborateurs car nous sommes convaincus que leur r\u00e9ussite est aussi la n\u00f4tre.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Chez Burson, nous sommes une agence d&#39;apprenants permanents. Nous savons que l&#39;excellence en cr\u00e9ativit\u00e9 et en communication exige une compr\u00e9hension fine et nuanc\u00e9e. C&#39;est pourquoi nous recherchons des collaborateurs talentueux de tous horizons et de toutes cultures. Ces talents sont essentiels pour concevoir des id\u00e9es audacieuses, favoriser un dialogue constructif, cr\u00e9er des exp\u00e9riences enrichissantes et stimuler l&#39;innovation pour nos clients. Votre point de vue unique, votre talent, fait de vous une #BursonPerson.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;En cliquant sur \u00ab Soumettre la candidature \u00bb, vous nous transmettez les informations saisies. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today\u2019s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Burson, we\u2019re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That\u2019s why it\u2019s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can\u2019t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view\u2014your talent\u2014is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it\u2019s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We believe the best work happens when we&#39;re together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. data-testid=&quot;job-section-process&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;sc-brzPDJ kmwlVI&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;sc-dBueTE jBdbxD&quot; data-is-text-too-long=&quot;false&quot; data-is-view-more=&quot;false&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;sc-jHEWpz kgAAkN&quot;&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Le processus de recrutement (on ne te fera pas passer 10 entretiens, promis) :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Envoie-nous ton CV (et une lettre de motivation si tu as envie de nous en dire plus sur toi).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Si ton profil nous int\u00e9resse, on te contactera pour un premier \u00e9change t\u00e9l\u00e9phonique.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Ensuite, tu rencontreras deux de nos consultants pour un entretien et la r\u00e9alisation d\u2019un cas pratique (histoire de voir comment tu r\u00e9agis face \u00e0 une situation concr\u00e8te).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Le d\u00e9briefing de cet exercice se fera directement pendant l\u2019entretien.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Rejoignez-nous !&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Si vous \u00eates passionn\u00e9(e) par la communication et souhaitez d\u00e9velopper vos comp\u00e9tences au sein d\u2019une agence de r\u00e9f\u00e9rence, envoyez-nous votre candidature (CV).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Pour en savoir plus sur Burson&amp;nbsp;:[[&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.bursonglobal.com\/locations\/france&quot; Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant o\u00f9 les collaborateurs motiv\u00e9s et ambitieux peuvent d\u00e9velopper leurs comp\u00e9tences, \u00e9tendre leur r\u00e9seau et \u00e9laborer des strat\u00e9gies innovantes pour les plus grandes marques. Nous avons \u00e9galement mis en place des programmes de reconnaissance et de fid\u00e9lisation pour nos meilleurs talents. de la transformation cr\u00e9ative.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Le stage est \u00e0 pourvoir \u00e0 partir de janvier 2027.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Le d\u00e9partement \u201cHealth &amp;amp; Wellness\u201d intervient notamment pour pr\u00e9server la r\u00e9putation des marques, des organisations et des entreprises, faire \u00e9voluer les comportements au travers de campagnes de pr\u00e9vention et de programmes de promotion de la sant\u00e9, valoriser les marques sant\u00e9\/bien-\u00eatre ou accompagner la communication pour des produits de sant\u00e9 aupr\u00e8s du grand public et des professionnels de sant\u00e9.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Missions :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Au sein de cette Practice \u201cHealth &amp;amp; Wellness\u201d et pour You will work hand in hand with the Brand &amp;amp; Communication Director, being her direct report.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you will be doing: &lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Owner of the development of Demand Generation brand activities, including brand campaigns (online and offline), chef partnership, social media and PR&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage the conception, planning, production and report of the brand activities, liaising with a wide range of stakeholders (including the Global Brand Team, Agencies, Local marketing teams) and ensuring that we deliver a quality result on time and on budget. Brand activities include a broad nature of projects such as video campaigns, offline campaigns, brand partnership campaigns, organic social media, stunts\u2026&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Analyse campaign performance and channel results; with strong people and communication skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to manage different projects, with efficient processes, respect of deadlines and budget conscience&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven management skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Autonomous, organised, proactive and adaptable&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fluency in English and French - both written and spoken&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What will you get?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A dynamic, international environment with a strong company culture&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A supportive, passionate, proactive and dynamic French team&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Offices in the heart of Paris, in the 1st arrondissement&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A hybrid setup combining remote work and time in the office&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Perks: HelloFresh discounts, Swile meal vouchers, Gymlib access, transport benefits, and everything else that makes coming to the office great&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Our recruitment process:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;ll review your profile. Summit\u2019s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Summit\u2019s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit\u2019s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Colorectal Cancer (CRC)&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China\u2019s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Piles \u00e0 Combustible","description":"<h2><strong>About EHG<\/strong><\/h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company.<\/p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\">\u00a0<\/div><h2><strong>The opportunity<\/strong><\/h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams \u2014 our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die \u2018deployments\u2019. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&amp;D-team.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Wat je gaat doen<\/strong><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. Je bent een sterke projectmanager.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Waarom Monumental?<\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen.
